repos.name: metaAria
repos.description: A desktop/web companion for rhythm game enthusiasts that parses any track, uses Muse Voice Transcribe to detect vocal cues, and leverages SAM 3.1 on album art/visualizers or video tracks to segment choreography/beats. Uses Muse Spark 1.3 / Muse Wonder to procedurally generate, test, and render playable rhythm charts and visual backgrounds.
